description: Lists added, removed, and modified file identities between two version refs, defaulting from published to head. Results use cursor pagination; pin continuation requests to the resolved version numbers.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page. Continue with the returned resolved versions to keep the comparison pinned.

from.description: Base side of the diff: a version number, `head`, or `published`. Defaults to `published`.

limit.description: Maximum candidate files to compare. Defaults to 20 and cannot exceed 20.

to.description: Target side of the diff: a version number, `head`, or `published`. Defaults to `head`.

name: websiteSourceCode_changes_list
title: List changed source files
